name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.wittPairing_mem_withExponents
summary: A form μ of C applied to b(y, x) is expanded by the Hodge basis criterion on L into products σ(y)ν(x) with σ a form of A of the complementary type; the Kisin, letter and filtration conditions follow from those of y and x.

steps.claim: For μ ∈ forms(C), x ∈ fracSpan(L), a letter i, u ∈ ℤ, m ∈ ℤ × Γ and n: if σ(m·y)·ν(m·x) ∈ hodgeFil(n) for every κ, ν ∈ formsOfType(L, i, κ) and σ ∈ forms(A) that is of type u − κ whenever μ is of type u, then μ(m·wittPairing(b)(y, x)) ∈ hodgeFil(n).
steps.lean:
have F {μ x y n m} hx (hμ : μ ∈ C.forms) i u (H : ∀ᵉ
    (κ) (ν ∈ L.formsOfType i κ) (σ ∈ A.forms), (μ ∈ C.formsOfType i u → σ ∈ A.formsOfType i
    (u - κ)) → σ (m • y) * ν (m • x) ∈ hodgeFil n) : μ (m • wittPairing b y x) ∈ hodgeFil n :=
    (μ.congr_arg (baseChangePairing_map _ (hb _) ..)).subst (L.mem_hodgeFil_of_hodge_basis
    (smul_mem_fracSpan m hx) fun _ _ e D f d ↦ (fun I ↦ H _ _ e
    (D.restrictScalars _ ∘ₗ ((wittPairing b).restrictScalars₁₂ ..).compr₂ μ) I fun h ↦ ⟨I, fun t ↦
    hodgeFil_anti (by omega) (f _ (-u) (by simp [wittPairing_letterProj_left, h.2]))⟩) fun t ↦
    (d _ _ · (by simp [hb, hμ _])))
steps.typed_fact: μ (m • wittPairing b y x) ∈ hodgeFil n

steps.claim: Proof: μ(m·b(y, x)) = μ(b(m·y, m·x)) (b equivariant, baseChangePairing_map); apply the Hodge basis criterion on L to x' ↦ μ(b(m·y, x')) with D = (ν' ↦ (the functional σ on W(C^♭)⊗A obtained from μ and ν' through b)): D is equivariant and shifts types by κ, so the hypothesis gives each term.
steps.lean:
(μ.congr_arg (baseChangePairing_map _ (hb _) ..)).subst (L.mem_hodgeFil_of_hodge_basis
    (smul_mem_fracSpan m hx) fun _ _ e D f d ↦ (fun I ↦ H _ _ e
    (D.restrictScalars _ ∘ₗ ((wittPairing b).restrictScalars₁₂ ..).compr₂ μ) I fun h ↦ ⟨I, fun t ↦
    hodgeFil_anti (by omega) (f _ (-u) (by simp [wittPairing_letterProj_left, h.2]))⟩) fun t ↦
    (d _ _ · (by simp [hb, hμ _])))

steps.claim: wittPairing(b)(y, x) ∈ kisinLocAinf(C): y, x lie in the saturations of kisinAinf by the φ^a E (wittPairing_mem_saturateBy), and for c ∈ kisinAinf(A), d ∈ kisinAinf(L), b(c, d) is in the τ-saturation of ainfLattice(C) (b of spans of 1⊗·) and μ(φ^{n+1}b(c, d)) ∈ B_dR^+ by step 1 with u = 0 (products of B_dR^+ elements).
